newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns A to Sony Capital dual-currency bond.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns A to Sony Capital dual-currency bond.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp (S&P) said on Friday that it had assigned an A rating to Sony Capital Corp's 25 billion yen yen/dollar dual-currency bond, which benefits from a keepwell agreement from Sony Capital's parent Sony Corp.
The outlook for the rating is stable, S&P said in a statement.
The rating reflects the Sony Group's prominent position in consumer and professional audiovisual products and the music industry as well as its satisfactory financial profile, S&P said.
